_about: Names, short write-ups and a featured NASA photo for each science stop, keyed by the first sol of the stop. Researched by Fizza from the Curiosity mission blog and NASA image pages. build_web_data.py merges these into web/data/site.json.

4537.title: Early Boxwork Bedrock
4537.blurb: Curiosity examined rocky terrain near the emerging boxwork formations, investigating bedrock textures and chemistry to better understand the region's geological history.

4541.title: First Boxwork Ridge
4541.blurb: One of Curiosity's first close investigations of boxwork formations, where mineral deposits from ancient groundwater may reveal Mars' past water history.

4548.title: Boxwork Bedrock & Troughs
4548.blurb: Curiosity studied exposed bedrock and troughs near emerging boxwork ridges, providing evidence to investigate how Martian rocks were altered and eroded.

4560.title: Altadena Drill Site
4560.blurb: Curiosity drilled into ancient boxwork-region bedrock here and analyzed the rock powder for minerals and chemical clues about Mars' past water conditions.

4575.title: Copacabana-Copiapo Boxwork Trough
4575.blurb: Curiosity studied fractured bedrock inside a boxwork trough to investigate mineral deposits and chemical evidence of ancient groundwater activity.

4580.title: Hornitos Veined Bedrock
4580.blurb: Curiosity examined possible mineral veins cutting through the bedrock, offering clues about ancient groundwater activity in Gale Crater.

4588.title: Guapay Ridges & Troughs
4588.blurb: Curiosity compared harder, resistant bedrock with lower, eroded troughs to understand why different parts of the boxwork terrain weather differently.
